text.text: Bare, unmarked, and someone has been through the pockets since.
No clothes, no wounds, no explanation.  Somebody undressed them, and it was not them.
Stripped to the skin.  Whoever did it was unhurried and thorough.
There is a pale band on one finger where a ring used to be.
They died of nothing you can see, and were robbed of everything you can't.
Laid out almost tidily.  That is somehow the worst part of it.

text.text: Fully dressed, no mark on them at all.  Their heart, most likely, and quickly.
Sitting where they sat down.  Nothing here attacked anybody.
No wound, no blood, no struggle.  Whatever it was came from inside.
One shoe is off and set neatly beside the other.  They had time for that much.
They look like they are about to get up, and they have looked like that for days.
Nobody has touched them.  Nobody has been here to.

text.text: Clothes soaked through and gone stiff.  It was fast, at least.
Something opened them up and did not stay to finish the job.
The blood has dried in a wide arc.  They were moving when it happened.
Their hands are the worst of it.  They tried to stop it with their hands.
Dragged a short way, then not dragged any further.
Whoever came through afterwards took what was easy and left the rest.

text.text: Face down in a pool gone tacky at the edges.
They got a few steps further than whoever they were with.
Curled around an injury they were holding shut.
A long smear leads to them and stops.
Killed reaching for a door that is still shut.
Somebody closed their eyes.  Somebody who then left.

//: One category per body type.  The item declares snippet_category, so each find reads differently from the last without needing six times the items.

text.text: Most of one side is gone.  Whatever was feeding stopped before it finished.
Fed on and abandoned.  The question is what interrupted it.
Ribs opened outward.  Nothing careful did this.
Their coat is intact where the rest of them is not.
The pockets have not been touched.  Nothing that eats people has any use for a wallet.
Enough is left to be sure it was a person, and not enough for much else.

text.text: Cut through cleanly at the waist by something that did not slow down.
Two halves, and not especially close together.
The cut is far too clean for teeth.
Something with an edge came through here at speed, and kept going.
The top half is still holding a set of keys.
Whatever did this was not hunting.  It was simply passing through.
